import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
plt.xkcd()
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6,4))
ax.set_xlim(0,10); ax.set_ylim(0,6); ax.set_aspect('equal')
ax.axis('off')
ax.text(5,5.6,'COLD ROOM AIRFLOW - SIDE VIEW',ha='center',fontsize=10)
# walls
ax.plot([1,9,9,1,1],[1,1,5,5,1],lw=2)
# crates
for x in [2.5,4.5,6.5]:
    for y in [1.3,2.3,3.3]:
        ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((x,y),1.5,0.8,fill=False,lw=1.2))
ax.text(5,1.0,'vented crates 1 tonne',ha='center',fontsize=8)
# evaporator high rear
ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((1.1,3.9,1.2,0.9),fill=False,lw=2))
ax.text(1.7,4.35,'evap',ha='center',fontsize=8)
# fans arrow forward on top
ax.annotate('',xy=(8.5,4.3),xytext=(2.5,4.3),arrowprops=dict(facecolor='black',arrowstyle='->',lw=1.5))
ax.text(5.5,4.6,'cold supply forward',ha='center',fontsize=8)
# return arrow low
ax.annotate('',xy=(1.5,1.5),xytext=(8.0,1.5),arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->',lw=1.2))
ax.text(5.5,1.7,'warm return low rear',ha='center',fontsize=8)
# condenser outside rear
ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((0.0,3.5,0.9,1.2),fill=False,lw=1.5,linestyle='--'))
ax.text(0.45,4.1,'cond',ha='center',fontsize=7)
ax.text(0.45,2.8,'heat out',ha='center',fontsize=7)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('sketch.png',dpi=150)
